description: Restored Lockheed L-1649A-98 Starliner c/n 1038 installed on the TWA Hotel apron at JFK Terminal 5 as the Connie Cocktail Lounge; open to the public as part of the hotel; some sources give the registration as N8083J - N8083H is the reading carried by Aerial Visuals; Aerial Visuals notes it still needs an exact map reference so the coordinate here is the hotel apron
